dialogues.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
dialogues.text: Phobos has guided you here, golden-haired outlander.

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: Lucius Patricius am I, a musician of our empire.

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: Be not alarmed, outlander. Unlike my kin who have been inundated by their dreams, I still maintain the tranquility of my melody.

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: This was, once upon a time, Portus Anticus. The most prosperous port in the empire. Today, it is our sepulcher.

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: If you seek the bronze bell that once dispersed the boundless ocean fog, then continue upward. Mayhap time and rust have not utterly devoured her.

choices.text: You seem pretty calm about all this...

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: The fall of the empire, the death of our God King... All these things were predestined. Getting emotional about events long-fated is unwise.

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: Why should one agonize over a matter that is merely a part of life? In truth, every moment in life is worthy of our tears.

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: Moreover, of what benefit is sorrow and resentment, if punishment cannot wipe away sin?

response.speaker: Nameless Stone Statue
response.text: Farewell, golden-haired outlander. May your music be tranquil.
